comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Truckload carrier hauling freight for shippers; not a railcar manufacturer, lessor or repairer.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Intermodal and trucking freight services provider; buys no railcars to build, so it is a different business.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Makes track components, coatings and concrete for rail infrastructure; does not build or lease freight railcars.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Car-hauler trucking for finished vehicles; a freight service, not railcar manufacturing.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Builds freight railcars (hoppers, gondolas) and components, and also leases, repairs and maintains railcars for the same customers.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Less-than-truckload trucking and brokerage service; different customers' needs and revenue model from railcar manufacturing.
